name: Cloud Enumeration Followed by Object Access
description: Synthetic detection mapping ListObjects, ListRoles and GetObject. The layer represents behavioural hypotheses, not proof of compromise or malicious intent.

techniques.comment: ListObjects: simulated cloud-storage object enumeration. Discovery mapping; does not establish malicious intent.
ListRoles: simulated cloud identity or role enumeration. Confirm the exact API semantics for the target provider.
GetObject: simulated access to cloud-stored data. A successful read alone does not prove malicious collection or exfiltration.
